summary: MCGS Slice 1 (Member Management) — backend + frontend BOTH pass. 15/15 pytest cases green on /api/cms/members list · profile · notes · warn · restore · delete-id-mismatch-rejection · admin_log dual-write. UI safeguard contract verified end-to-end: ConfirmIdentityAction dialog appears before every consequential action, primary button stays disabled until BOTH (reason ≥3 chars) AND (identity-checkbox ticked) — for delete, additionally requires typed Member-ID to match. Verified with wrong id (disabled) then correct id (enabled). Escape closes without submit. Keyboard shortcuts w/s/b open matching dialogs, n focuses note textarea. Add-note composer writes to timeline (Notes 2→3, Actions total 16→17). Members list shows 101 seed members with search + status filter + pagination. Retired mobile screen confirmed via source read — shows 'Moved to Mission Control' copy with member id + back-to-admin-home button, no moderation actions possible from mobile.

issues: Cancel button has autoFocus in JSX but reason textarea also has autoFocus={!requiresTypedId} — reason wins the focus race, so 'Cancel is default focus' from the migration audit is not strictly true for warn/suspend/ban/restore (only for delete, where reason has no autoFocus). Non-blocking: reason-first focus is arguably better UX for typing the reason; but if the audit requires Cancel-first for defensive default, main agent may want to remove autoFocus from the reason textarea.

React console warning: 'a style property during rerender when a conflicting property is set can lead to styling bugs. Do not mix shorthand and non-shorthand properties for the same value.' Likely a style-object merge in one of the members components. Non-blocking but worth cleaning.

action_items: Optional: remove autoFocus from the reason textarea in ConfirmIdentityAction so the Cancel button retains default focus per MCGS_MIGRATION_AUDIT.md — trade-off vs faster reason typing.
Optional: track down the React 'shorthand/non-shorthand style' warning firing on the member profile page (harmless but adds noise to prod console).
critical_code_review_comments: ConfirmIdentityAction:107-109 — canSubmit gates on (identityChecked && reasonOk && idOk && !submitting). All three conditions independently verified in UI: identity-check untick re-locks the button, wrong typed-id keeps delete locked, empty/short reason keeps warn/suspend/ban/delete locked. Safeguard contract holds.
members/[id]/page.tsx:71-85 — keyboard shortcut listener correctly bails on INPUT/TEXTAREA targets and meta/ctrl/alt modifiers, so shortcuts never fire while the admin is typing a note or reason.

cms_module.py delete route (verified via test_delete_rejects_id_mismatch and test_delete_rejects_empty_confirm) returns 4xx when confirm_member_id != path user_id — server-side is the ultimate safeguard, not just the UI.

MemberProfilePage:87-99 — the memberRow useMemo mirrors every restriction/status field into the dialog + identity header, so ConfirmIdentityAction and MemberIdentityHeader render EXACTLY the same identity (matches the audit's 'consistent identity everywhere' rule).

Retired mobile screen /app/frontend/app/admin/user/[id].tsx correctly renders 'Moved to Mission Control' with Ionicons rocket icon, member-id display, 'Why the change?' explanation, and single 'Back to admin home' action — no moderation buttons remain.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on safeguard contract (all 5 actions + typed-id + escape + keyboard shortcuts + note composer)
